semantic_review: ウラ is 언더 and オモテ is 일반 인터넷 in network contrast; candidate wording not a newly approved glossary. ジゴクの1チョウメ keeps numeric1 as 지옥의1번지 metaphor, not a real mapped location.
7B32B0:5 intentionally compresses native battle call as 배틀오페세인, not normalizing it into a new page.6 keeps ironic 승부 defeat vs 싸움 victory, not reversing actual outcome.

7B469C:4 asserts similarity from the speaker perspective, not a confirmed player alignment;12 forced encounter has no added decline.12 and16 share native battle178/656 but have separate outcome scripts; unchanged even if they look duplicated.

Shop portrait PurpleNavi remains visible on options; choices are player-choice,221 inherits223/224. Shop7 normal vs17 ladies branch and source stock refusal retained. No discount percentage/weekday invented.

7B4A6C uses2000zenny, tournament bitmask8 and source multi-flag requirements; do not borrow Official free or1000zenny terms. Entry weekday/time and sleeping111 preserved; no inferred number of wins/bosses added.
GoldProg restores chip use counts via callClearBattleChipGateHistory, not HP/new chips/save erasure. Phonetic キラ and ブラッディパーティ/봉주르 remain human-review candidates.
